criteria.question: Does this part build academic language, such as vocabulary, inferential talk, or retelling events in order?
criteria.search_query: teach academic language inferential narrative language vocabulary

criteria.question: Does this part help students hear and work with the sounds in spoken words, and connect those sounds to letters?
criteria.search_query: phonemic awareness segment blend sounds link to letters

criteria.question: Does this part teach students to decode words and recognize common spelling patterns or word parts?
criteria.search_query: teach students to decode words analyze word parts sound-spelling patterns

criteria.question: Is the new skill in this part modeled by the teacher before students practice it?
criteria.search_query: explicit instruction teacher modeling before practice

criteria.question: Do students read connected text with support here, such as reading aloud with feedback or repeated reading?
criteria.search_query: read connected text daily guided oral reading feedback fluency

criteria.question: Does this part help students read for meaning, such as checking understanding or discussing the text?
criteria.search_query: reading for understanding comprehension monitor meaning

criteria.question: Do students practice here with the teacher giving prompts, scaffolds, or corrective feedback?
criteria.search_query: guided practice scaffolding corrective feedback word reading

criteria.question: Does the material state what students will learn, in a way the teacher could check?
criteria.search_query: clear learning objective for reading instruction lesson goals

criteria.question: Do the activities work toward the stated goal?
criteria.search_query: align instruction and activities to the learning goal

criteria.question: Does the material build skills in a planned order, simple to complex?
criteria.search_query: systematic sequence of instruction simple to complex skills

criteria.question: Does the material check whether students learned the skill?
criteria.search_query: assess student progress monitor reading skills

criteria.question: Does the material plan support for students who need extra help or challenge?
criteria.search_query: small group instruction support struggling readers differentiation

criteria.question: Do students get enough time actively practicing the target skill?
criteria.search_query: daily practice time active student practice reading skills
